# Antony Perez

> Software engineer in the San Francisco Bay Area, open to software engineering roles. Builds browser courses that run real compilers in WebAssembly, a DCS cockpit trainer, a live Roblox game, and the CI and Kubernetes infrastructure under them.

- Email: antonyperez0@yahoo.com
- Résumé (PDF): https://antonyperez.com/resume.pdf
- GitHub: https://github.com/AntonyPerez0
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/antonyperez-swe

## Selected work

- [Arena courses](https://cpparena.com): free C/C++, Java, Rust and Python courses where every exercise is compiled and run in the browser (Clang 20 in WebAssembly, javac 21 on a Rust JVM, rustc, CPython 3.14 via Pyodide). RustArena alone: 9,000+ visitors a month. Sites: https://cpparena.com, https://javaarena.com, https://rustarena.app, https://pythonarena.org
- [SortiePrep](https://sortieprep.com/): DCS World cockpit trainer; a simulated aircraft decides when each checklist step is done. F-14B and F/A-18C, 409 procedure steps. Source: https://github.com/AntonyPerez0/Interactive-F-14-startup-simulator
- [Anomaly Grove](https://www.roblox.com/games/88948987401653/Anomaly-Grove): live Roblox tycoon, 24,000 lines of strict Luau across 142 modules, 240 tests. Source: https://github.com/AntonyPerez0/anomaly-grove
- [CS2 Pro Configs](https://copyprosta.com/): his most-visited site, with 16,000+ visitors a month. 620 Counter-Strike 2 pros' settings as ready-to-paste console commands, with crosshairs converted to CS2's new crosshair system, rebuilt weekly by GitHub Actions. Source: https://github.com/AntonyPerez0/cs2-pro-configs
- [GitOps homelab](https://github.com/AntonyPerez0/homelab): bare-metal Kubernetes on Talos Linux, deployed by FluxCD and Kustomize, 18 self-hosted services, Falco runtime detection.

Visitor counts are Cloudflare's unique visitors for the 30 days to 9 November 2026.

## More projects

- [Spritespeak](https://antonyperez0.github.io/spritespeak/): Game Boy emulator that translates the screen as you play.
- [News Dashboard](https://newsdash.page): ambient headlines for a second monitor.
- [Job Autopilot](https://github.com/AntonyPerez0/job-autopilot-desktop): Electron desktop app (macOS, Windows) that applies to jobs using only résumé lines the user approved, with rule-based and AI fact checks.
- [BuildForge](https://antonyperez0.github.io/buildforge/): build companions for Diablo IV and World of Warcraft.
- [Baseline Control](https://antonyperez0.github.io/baseline-control/): EIA-649 configuration-management simulator.
